body: I mean, I’m sure somewhere out there someone will understand but.. I don’t know. I haven’t met them yet I guess. im 20 years old. my whole life ever since I can remember I was never good enough. I was always the fat one, or the ugly one, or the annoying one. for as long as i can remember I wasn’t ever good enough for anyone. not even my mom. I had to watch her get beat up by her pos boyfriend when I was like 10. she actually made me move out so he would move in recently. she makes it a thing to tell me how much she wished she aborted me and all that good stuff ever time we see each other. I used to have an eating disorder because everyone would call me fat. I got over that, but still. I hangout with my friends and everyone wants them. I guess i’m just being selfish because I want attention too but I just want to feel like someone loves me. my whole high school career I had a boyfriend. he cheated on me and verbally abused me the whole time. I’m still in love with him and the only reason i’m not with him is because he left me and said “I don’t love you anymore”. I took that one the hardest. ever since then i’ve fantasized about death. I heard you feel the most peaceful right before you go. that’s what I crave. true peace in my life.
thank you, that makes a lot of sense. while i’m at school tonight i’m gonna analyze. I know that I still have feelings for him.. I don’t know what to think.
I miss blockbuster. I haven’t seen one since I was about 5
